title: I burned out. Now I don't know how to start again.
why_read: A personal, informal post about programmer burnout with little technical content, more of a community check-in than a technical resource.
analysis: This is a first-person account of a developer returning after a period of burnout, describing loss of motivation and difficulty restarting coding work, and asking the community for advice. It contains no technical content, code, or engineering insight, and is purely a personal/emotional reflection. While burnout is a real and important issue in the industry, this particular piece doesn't add new perspective or actionable strategies beyond generic encouragement. It may have value as peer support content but doesn't fit a technical digest focused on engineering substance.
